title: Portfolio Update (GTX, MSB, FRMO, TPL)
summary:
We purchased Garrett Motion, ticker symbol GTX, in 2020, when it was going through bankruptcy
and it's the largest special situation in our portfolios. Earlier this month, my co-host and I traveled to New York City and attended FRMO's annual
shareholder meeting, highlights from the trip included iconic sightseeing, lunch
with two friends from Horizon It continues to confound us how few investors appreciate the unique wisdom of Maurice Stahl
and ignore what he and his team are building at Horizon Kinetics and FRMO.

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to episode 133 of Special Situation Investing.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to episode 133 of Special Situation Investing. It's been three months since our last portfolio update. We use these pieces to summarize updates from quarterly reports and earnings calls of companies in our portfolios and occasional honorable mentions from our watchlist.
